added_lines: Looking ahead to next year, we look forward to our Meath Diocesan Pilgrimage to Seoul, South Korea, for World Youth Day , 27th July-10th August 2027. There are only a few places left to join the Meath Diocesan group. If interested please contact the Parish Office or one of the priests of the parish . A preparation day for Seoul will take place in Dalgan Park, Navan at 3 pm on 13th December . Many priests from our diocese have served as missionaries in Korea and one was martyred there during the Korean War. WYD gives us a chance to honour their memory and experience the parishes they established. See

. Be a part of our Youth Mass. Our Saturday Vigil Mass (6 pm) at the Cathedral is our Youth Mass—a space for young people from CBS, Loreto, St Finian’s and more to serve and grow in faith. From bringing up the gifts to proclaiming the Word, every role is a chance to live your faith in action. Sign-ups are open now— visit the Parish website under Faith Formation for details . Volunteers will have a walk- through before the first Mass. Bible Study: The Advent of the Messiah. This season ready your heart for the coming of Christ. We will explore the meaning of Advent by looking at links between the Old and New Testament - with the promise of the Messiah, the Annunciation and the Visitation. Wednesdays, 25 Nov - 2 Dec - 9 Dec | 7.30 - 9 pm | Bethany Space Three sessions to be held; Advent resources will be shared to carry you through to Christmas. Questions? Email:

Advent A time of waiting, conversion, and hope: Waiting: memory of the first humble coming of the Lord, and supplication for his final, glorious coming; Conversion: listening to the call of the prophets, and especially of John the Baptist, to return to the Lord; Hope: that the salvation already accomplished by Christ will reach its fullness in us, through grace, and that “we shall become like him ”.
